profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I love learning. The world is an infinite library of knowledge waiting to be explored. As I explore what the world has to offer, I am careful to pay attention to details, resulting in the opportunity to see things that others do not notice. As a result of being unafraid to ask questions, the level of knowledge I receive is exponentiated. The process of gaining this knowledge is accompanied by my love of finding patterns and using these patterns to solve problems. In each situation I experience, I find myself gathering data, defining explicit problems, analyzing the problems and creating solutions to the problems. My goal is to become a mathematician working in the field of Data Science continuously learning, finding patterns and solving problems.

positions.title: Deep Learning Research Assistant
positions.description: Working to improve unsupervised clustering algorithms

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Member of mathematics of network research team and fire modeling/machine learning team. Proving relationship to quantify link prediction metric Katz distance. 
Discovering meaningful patterns in data to present to the lab that owns the data

positions.title: Math grader
positions.description: Responsible to accurately grade homework of 30 students in Calculus 1. Accurately record sctudents' scores in the gradebook. Provide feedback to assist students in learning from their mistakes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Explore and develop AI/ML applications to improve developer productivity
Implemented JavaScript parser in Python to collect data that was used to train a function generation transformer model

positions.title: Physical Science Technician
positions.description: Assist in the tests of certain biological and chemical warfare tests, including setting up material (gasmets), running the equipment and taking down the test materials.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Member of a research group working to 3D print a blood vessel. Gained experience in passaging, imaging and statistically analyzing endothelial cells. Trained in life sciences, general lab safety, biosafety cabinet and working with formaldehyde. Investigated the optimal 3D bioprinting parameters.

positions.title: Summer Hire Associate
positions.description: Performed various daily maintenance and logistical tasks as needed within the company to ensure production ran smoothly.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computational and Applied Mathematics; Machine Learning Emphasis
